# Security Policy

**PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY.**

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within NativePHP for Mobile, please send an email to support@nativephp.com or use GitHub's [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/NativePHP/mobile-air/security/advisories/new).

All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.
